---
title: "ggplot svg"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    fig-format: svg
    theme: lux
execute: {warning: false}
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, colour = Species)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~Species)
```

```{r}
ggplot(ggplot2::economics, aes(date, unemploy)) + geom_line()
```
